name: Crewmate Rush Space Escape Runner
storyline: Deep in outer space, a catastrophic malfunction breaches the high-tech research vessel, unleashing the ancient Void Hunter. As an elite astronaut crewmate, you must sprint through collapsing spaceship corridors, dodge deadly high-energy lasers, and bypass hazardous environmental traps. To ensure survival, the crew must perform crucial emergency tasks under pressure while making a desperate run toward the escape pods before the entire vessel is consumed.
summary:
Crewmate Rush Space Escape Runner is a feature-rich, high-octane 3D sci-fi runner where players sprint through high-tech spaceship corridors, dodge lethal hazards, and escape the pursuing Void Hunter.

Designed with deep gameplay mechanics and robust social integration, the game offers a complete multi-platform arcade experience across web and mobile platforms.
